About Apple Orchard India

Apple Orchard India is a free guide for apple growers, published by Gujarat Bio Organics Pvt. Ltd., a manufacturer of organic fertilizers, biostimulants and biofertilizers in Bhavnagar, Gujarat, working with farmers since 2006, including apple growers in Himachal Pradesh and Jammu & Kashmir.

Who writes it

Pages are written and reviewed by Gafar Laiya, founder of Gujarat Bio Organics, with the company's field team.

Where the information comes from

Dr. Y.S. Parmar University of Horticulture & Forestry (Nauni), SKUAST-Kashmir, SKUAST-Jammu, ICAR-Central Institute of Temperate Horticulture, the National Horticulture Board, the Ministry of Agriculture, USDA FAS, the National Innovation Foundation, NITI Aayog and DPPQ&S/CIB&RC. Sources are listed on each page.

Our rules

  • No yield promises; yields shown are research and good-orchard figures.
  • Pesticides are named by active ingredient only; doses come from the official spray schedule and label. Banned chemicals are flagged.
  • Our own products are clearly marked as ours.
